About the Conference(ICECS'2024)
AAACET invites you to participate in the INTERNATIC NALCONFERENCEONENVIRONMENTALDEVELOPMENTUSINGCOMPUTER
SCIENCE (ICECS'2024), to be conducted on 11-12" January, 2024 at AAA College of Engineering and Technology in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India. The
role of artificial intelligence and the application of data analytics in computer science bring out new and valid insights for the various demanding requirements
in the field of the environment and its developments. Researchers are actively identifying opportunities for improvement and optimising their designs for
maximum sustainability by collecting and analysing data on energy consumption, emissions, and other environmental factors. With the application of data
analytics and other tools, renewable energy development, transportation optimisation, and waste reduction, computer science has the potential to
revolutionise sustainable engineering and make our world a more sustainable place.ICECS'2024 provides an excellent platform for academia, scientists,
research scholars, and practicing experts, bringing them together to showcase their impactful and innovative ideas on energy, environmental conservation,
societal environmental sustainabilityneeds,andothertopics ofinterest.

SCIENCE (ICECS'2024), to be conducted on 11-12" January, 2024 at AAA College of Engineering and Technology in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India. The
role of artificial intelligence and the application of data analytics in computer science bring out new and valid insights for the various demanding requirements
in the field of the environment and its developments. Researchers are actively identifying opportunities for improvement and optimising their designs for
maximum sustainability by collecting and analysing data on energy consumption, emissions, and other environmental factors. With the application of data
analytics and other tools, renewable energy development, transportation optimisation, and waste reduction, computer science has the potential to
revolutionise sustainable engineering and make our world a more sustainable place.ICECS'2024 provides an excellent platform for academia, scientists,
research scholars, and practicing experts, bringing them together to showcase their impactful and innovative ideas on energy, environmental conservation,
societal environmental sustainabilityneeds,andothertopics ofinterest.

CLOUD
MASTERS
-2019
With the increasing demand for Cloud Computing jobs and the rising need for focused learning
towards Cloud Computing,ICT Academy in collaboration with AwS Educate is organizing a Region
wise Faculty Enrichment Program in multiple cities to teachfaculty on Cloud fundamentals.It's a
one-day program for educators that will provide the training and resources to accelerate cloud-
related learning.
On successful completion of the program,each participating faculty should organize Cloud
Literacy Day in their respective institution to motivate and train students on Cloud Fundamentals.
Duration Participants Training Locations
1 Day (8 Hours) Faculty members of Engineering, Chennai, Coimbatore,Madurai,

In an effort to remind current and future generations of the deep scars left
by the Partition,Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced in 202l that Augustl4
would be observed annually as Partition Horrors Remembrance Day'.
The observance aims to commemorate the sacrifices made by those who suffered
during the Partition and to keep their memories alive.
The ECE Department is organizing a programme for observing the Partition
HorrorsRemembranceDay2024on14-08-2024@ 3.00PMintheThomasAlwa
Edison Hallby screening the video script.
The script of the play is designed to educate and raise awareness among
students about the events of Partition, curated by the National School of Drama
(NSD) and endorsed by the UGC - D.0.No.2-47/2023 (CPP-II 07 th August, 2024.
All the III Year ECE students are asked to attend the Programme without fail.

systems undervariableandpartial shading conditions
C. Karuppasamy,, C. Senthil Kumar , R. Ganesan b, P. Elamparithis

Department of Artificial Inteligence and Data Science, Ramco Institute of Technology, Rajapalayam, 626117, India
ARTICLEINFO ABSTRACT
Keywords: The development of MPPT algorithms is crucial for optimizing energy utilization in photovoltaic systems.This
Dynamic wavelet neural network manuscript introduces a hybrid method to enhance MPPT perfomance under partial shading conditions by
Aquilaoptimizationalgorithm optimizing PID control. The proposed AOA-DWNN method integrates the Aquila Optimization Algorithm (AOA)
Photovoltaic for tuning PID gain settings and the Dynamic Wavelet Neural Network (DWNN) for predicting optimal converter
PID controller parameters. This combination improves power tracking accuracy and optimizes energy utilization in varying
Boostconvertor environmental conditions.The method is put into practice in MATLAB and compared with existing methods,
Inverter
including the Salp Swarm Algorithm and Sine Cosine Algorithm (SSA-SCA), Firefly Algorithm and Particle Swarm
Optimization (FA-PSO), and Artificial Bees Colony and Cuckoo Search Algorithm (ABC-CSA). The results
demonstratea significantly lower error rate of0.89%, compared to1.5%,1.2%,and1% in existing approaches.
Additionally,the proposed technique achieves an efficiency of99.96%, surpassing the98.94%,97.95%, and
96.94 % of other methods. The findings highlight the effectiveness of the AOA-DWNN technique in improving
photovoltaic system performance, ensuring more accurate and reliable MPPT operation under partial shading
conditions.
